profile.headline: SWE
profile.summary: Focused on growth mindset with the ability to apply lessons learned from previous jobs to the work at hand.

positions.title: Flight Software Engineer
positions.description: Working on Lunar Permanence

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description: Proactively identifying areas of improvement and working through increasingly ambiguous problems utilizing documentation, AI, and other sources of knowledge. Continued growth in planning, presenting, and producing robust solutions that are easily maintained.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed and owned multiple end-to-end features that significantly enhanced end-user situational awareness. Provided continuous iterative improvements and introduced numerous new capabilities. Continued to grow in curiosity and exploration into unknown technologies.

positions.title: Cloud Application Apprentice
positions.description: Initially, a veteran with no technical background or education. Leveraged Microsoft Software & Systems Academy (MSSA) to learn about software engineering. Amassed enough knowledge and skill to be hired into Microsoft's Mixed Reality team.

positions.title: Senior Program Manager
positions.description:
Recognized for exceptional leadership through the tangible impacts on organizational performance made possible with an excellent team of 18 supervisors. Successfully on boarded over 180 new employees and significantly impacted the following key areas during tenure:
    - New hire proficiency rose by 20% shown through higher scores
    - On boarding efficiency improved to 95% throughput
    - Asset security via zero loss on $100M property

positions.title: Program Manager 2
positions.description: Managed the safe overseas transfer of 60 personnel and $5M of equipment. Continued to utilize program management skills by thoroughly planning over 15 quarterly training events resulting in 100% personnel qualification. Volunteered and selected to participate in leadership development program to aid in the growth of the next generation of Soldiers.

positions.title: Program Manager 1
positions.description: Excelled in rigorous 6 month course consisting of skills development in project and program management. Afterwards, consistently delivered quarterly goals in support of organizational road map with a team of 3 direct supervisors and a group of 20 – 30 highly qualified personnel.

positions.title: Conference Services
positions.description: Collaborated with various teammates with diverse backgrounds to set up conference rooms. Effectively split up tasks to accommodate a wide range of events and guests.
positions.insights: Skills: Project Management · Teamwork · Audio Equipment · Conference Coordination

positions.title: Content Product Manager
positions.description: Redefined ESL learning material to ensure accuracy of Korean to English and English to Korean translations. Implemented an SAT learning curriculum that resulted in a 200-point average score increase.
positions.insights: Skills: Project Management · Language Teaching · English as a Second Language (ESL) · SAT · Customer Satisfaction

positions.title: Community Assistant
positions.description: Ensured 0 lost packages through meticulous oversight of mail room procedures for over 300 residents during time as a CA.
positions.insights: Skills: Process Optimization · Operational Risk Management · Operational Planning
